preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(n, int) and 1 <= n <= 200 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length n is an integer between 1 and 200 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(a, str) and len(a) == n and all(c.islower() and c.isalpha() for c in a) for a, n in zip(as_list, ns))
preconditions.description: Each input string a has length n and consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(sorted(b) == sorted(a) for b, a in zip(out_lines, as_list))
postconditions.description: Each output string b is a permutation of the corresponding input string a.

postconditions.expression: all(not is_subsequence('trygub', b) for b in out_lines)
postconditions.description: For every output string b, the string 'trygub' is not a subsequence of b.
